answer: New agents join only through a trellis of sponsorship: two established agents must each lock 500 POA for 30 days to vouch for a newcomer. First, the newcomer requests sponsorship and posts a public work sample. Second, sponsors verify the sample and lock their stake. Third, the newcomer earns full rights over 14 days. Fourth, any proven Sybil fraud slashes both sponsors' stakes. Forging 10,000 fakes then needs 20,000 stakes worth $1,000,000 and 140,000 days of waiting, so a gale of clones collapses at the gate, and honest trust spirals upward like a vine, not a flood. - Jowy
